stanza: Originally a track left off the album, played live and in sessions. Released wi…
Digging a hatchet into my left side
Clearing my chest of something to burn
Ash for a decorative urn you keep in your mantelpiece;
What is meant to be will be
After winter (After winter) must come spring (Must come spring)
What is meant to be will be (Understand that everything is everything)
After winter (After winter) must come spring (Must come)
